title: 第十九章 黄雀再后第二十章 我是猎人
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
“啊！！！”
凄厉的惨叫声刚刚响起，便戛然而止。
张麻子整个人被孙管事大手提在半空，双腿无力乱蹬。
炼气一层后期修为，在那股恐怖吞噬之力面前，竟连一丝浪花都翻不起来。
“救......救命......”
张麻子眼珠暴突，向着三丫和李狗蛋伸手。
他想要求助，却怎么都不能再发出声。
眼里画面，只剩下两人阴晴不定的脸。
“嘶溜。”
孙管事猛然一吸，张麻子浑身精血化作一道道红线，顺着七窍涌入孙管事体内。
短短三息。
原本壮硕的汉子，变成一具干瘪枯黄的人皮骷髅。
随手将人皮扔进泥水里，孙管事微眯双眸。
随着这股庞大精血入腹，他身上的伤势肉眼可见地愈合。
本就强悍气势，再度上涨。
炼气二层巅峰......半步炼气三层！
节节攀升之间，隐隐有突破到炼气三层的架势！
“妙......太妙了。”
闭着眼，孙管事陶醉道：
“修士的血肉，果然比凡人滋补百倍。早知如此，我又何必苦苦压抑这么久？”

说罢，他缓缓睁开眼。-
在这漆黑雨夜中，宛如两盏摄人心魄鬼灯。
“完了......”
三丫面如死灰，手中长鞭“哐当”一声跌落在地。
从外门贬入杂役院，她做好牺牲一切的打算，只望能重回仙门。
她算计了一些，步步为营，终是成功将孙肥猪拖入走火入魔的境地。
原以为万无一失，可唯独低估魔修的恐怖。
“逃！快逃！！”
反应过来的三丫，尖叫着就要往院外冲。
“跑？”
“想跑到哪里去！”
狞笑一声，孙管事单手掐诀，对着地面重重一按。
嗡！
一道血色触手从地下钻出，直接将刚腾空而起的三丫拉回地面。
砰。
被拽住脚踝的三丫，重重摔在地上，口吐鲜血。
不给她反应，两只血手又从地上钻出，死死将她束缚住。
“你这万人骑的贱胚子，还想往哪跑？”
“等老子收拾完那个白眼狼，把你压回外门听后发落！”
孙管事冷声骂了一句。

三丫虽说受了一点处罚来杂役院，但终究没失去外门身份。
合欢峰的那群鸟人，可不是那么好惹的。
content_en:
"Ah!!!"
The shrill screams stopped abruptly as soon as they started.
Zhang Mazi was held up in the air by Manager Sun's big hand, and his legs were unable to kick around.
At the late stage of Qi refining, in the face of that terrifying devouring force, he couldn't even stir up a single wave.
"Help...help..."
Zhang Mazi's eyes popped out and he reached out towards Sanya and Li Goudan.
He wanted to ask for help, but he couldn't make a sound.
The only thing left in his eyes was the uncertain faces of the two people.
"Hiss Liu."
Steward Sun took a sudden breath, and the essence and blood all over Zhang Mazi's body turned into red threads, pouring into Steward Sun's body along the seven orifices.
Just three breaths.
The originally strong man turned into a shriveled and yellow skeleton of human skin.
After casually throwing the human skin into the muddy water, Manager Sun narrowed his eyes.
As this huge amount of essence and blood entered his abdomen, the injuries on his body healed visibly.
The already strong momentum rose again.
The peak of the second level of Qi refining...the third level of Qi refining in half a step!
As he climbed higher and higher, he seemed to be reaching the third level of Qi Refining!
"Wonderful...wonderful."
With his eyes closed, Manager Sun said intoxicatedly:
"The flesh and blood of monks is indeed a hundred times more nourishing than that of mortals. If I had known this, why would I have to suppress it for so long?"
After saying that, he slowly opened his eyes. -
In this dark rainy night, they are like two soul-stirring ghost lights.
"It's over..."
The third girl's face was ashen, and the long whip in her hand fell to the ground with a clang.
Demoted from the Outer Gate to the Miscellaneous Service Courtyard, she was ready to sacrifice everything, just hoping to return to the Immortal Gate.
She made some calculations, step by step, and finally succeeded in dragging Sun Fatty into a crazy situation.
I thought it was foolproof, but I underestimated the terror of the demon cultivator.
"Run! Run away!!"
After Sanya reacted, she screamed and rushed out of the hospital.
"Run?"
"Run wherever you want!"
With a sinister laugh, Manager Sun made a secret with one hand and pressed the ground heavily.
Buzz!
A bloody tentacle emerged from the ground and directly pulled Sanya back to the ground.
Bang.
Sanya was grabbed by the ankle and fell heavily to the ground, vomiting blood.
Without giving her a reaction, two bloody hands emerged from the ground and bound her tightly.
"You're such a bastard with thousands of people riding on you, where else do you want to run?"
"When I finish taking care of that white-eyed wolf, I'll push you back to the outer door and let you know how to deal with it!"
Manager Sun cursed coldly.
Although Sanya was punished a little and came to the courtyard, she did not lose her status as an outsider after all.
The group of birdmen at Hehuan Peak are not so easy to offend.
